name: reAPI
summary: One API and prepaid credits for many image, video, audio and chat models, with an asynchronous task model.
notes: Image, video and audio models are asynchronous: submit, then poll reapi.task.get; chat models answer in the same request (not listed here).
Prepaid credits, 1 credit is $0.001; failed tasks are refunded automatically.
Preview models are not callable; check a model's availability on its models page first. Media inputs must be public HTTP(S) URLs.
The catalog changes often; the per-model request fields live in https://reapi.ai/models/<slug>/llms.txt.

endpoints.name: Submit an image generation task
endpoints.summary: Starts an asynchronous image job on one of reAPI's image models (GPT Image, Nano Banana, Seedream, FLUX, Imagen, Qwen and more).

model.description: Model id, e.g. nano-banana-2-1 or flux-2-pro; the slug of its models page.

prompt.example: A clean infographic poster of how coffee is made

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio, e.g. auto, 1:1, 16:9, 9:16; the allowed set depends on the model.

resolution.description: Resolution tier, e.g. 1k, 2k, 4k; the allowed set depends on the model.

image_urls.description: Public HTTP(S) URLs of reference or source images; base64 is rejected.

webhook_url.description: Public https URL that receives one POST with the finished task.

notes: Asynchronous: the response is {id, model, status: processing}. Poll reapi.task.get with that id every 1 to 2 seconds until status is completed (output holds the result URLs) or failed (credits refunded).
The accepted fields differ per model: each model's own page at https://reapi.ai/models/<slug>/llms.txt lists them; only the common ones are declared here.
Billing: prepaid credits (1 credit is $0.001), charged per completed output; failed tasks are refunded.

endpoints.name: Submit a video generation task
endpoints.summary: Starts an asynchronous video job on one of reAPI's video models (Seedance, Kling, Veo, Wan, MiniMax, Vidu and more).

model.description: Model id, the slug of its models page.

prompt.example: A clay lighthouse keeper climbs a spiral staircase

duration.description: Length in seconds; limits depend on the model (3 to 20 for kling-4-0-flash).

resolution.description: Resolution tier, e.g. 720p; depends on the model.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio, e.g. auto, 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 21:9; depends on the model.

image_urls.description: Public HTTP(S) URLs of reference or first-frame images.

video_urls.description: Public HTTP(S) URLs of source or reference videos.

webhook_url.description: Public https URL that receives one POST with the finished task.

notes: Asynchronous: the response is {id, model, status: processing}. Poll reapi.task.get with that id every 1 to 2 seconds until status is completed (output holds the result URLs) or failed (credits refunded).
The accepted fields differ per model: each model's own page at https://reapi.ai/models/<slug>/llms.txt lists them; only the common ones are declared here.
Billed per second of output for most video models; see the model page for the live price.

endpoints.name: Submit an audio or music generation task
endpoints.summary: Starts an asynchronous audio job on a model such as Suno or Mureka.

model.description: Model id, the slug of its models page.

prompt.description: Description or lyrics, as the model expects.

webhook_url.description: Public https URL that receives one POST with the finished task.

notes: Asynchronous: the response is {id, model, status: processing}. Poll reapi.task.get with that id every 1 to 2 seconds until status is completed (output holds the result URLs) or failed (credits refunded).
The accepted fields differ per model: each model's own page at https://reapi.ai/models/<slug>/llms.txt lists them; only the common ones are declared here.

endpoints.name: Get a task's status and output
endpoints.summary: Status and result of a task started by reapi.image.generate, reapi.video.generate or reapi.audio.generate.

id.description: The id returned when the task was submitted.

include.description: Comma-separated extras, e.g. billing or webhook.

notes: Polls the task started by reapi.image.generate, reapi.video.generate or reapi.audio.generate. status is processing, completed or failed.
Output URLs are rehosted on reAPI's CDN and do not expire. The rate limit is 50 requests a second per user, polling included.
